## Type

<!-- Matches the Conventional Commit type on your commits. -->

- [ ] `feat` — new user-facing capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `perf` — performance, no behaviour change
- [ ] `refactor` — neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `docs` / `test` / `build` / `ci` / `chore`

## Verification

<!-- How you know it works. Real cards and real file counts beat "looks fine". -->

- [ ] `make build` passes
- [ ] `make test` passes, or there is still no test target
- [ ] Tested against a real card
